title: A Late-Night Cafe on the Bangalore–Mysore Expressway, Open Till 6am
description: Looking for cafes open till late night near Bangalore? Fernway by Stories in Mayaganahalli is open every day till 6am — midnight dining and coffee on the expressway.
imageAlt: Fernway by Stories garden lit up at night, a late-night cafe on the Bangalore–Mysore Expressway

sections.heading: When the city closes, Fernway is just getting started
paragraphs: Plenty of cafes wind down around midnight. Fernway by Stories stays open every day from {{hoursDisplay}}, which makes it one of the few places on the Bangalore–Mysore Expressway where you can sit down for a proper meal, a coffee or a drink long after the city has gone quiet.
We call ourselves a cafe because that is how most people search for a late-night spot — but Fernway is a full garden restaurant, with a kitchen that keeps cooking through the night.

sections.heading: What midnight dining looks like here
paragraphs: Open-air garden tables, warm lights, candlelit tables every night and a menu built for long conversations.
list: North Indian favourites like chatpata chicken tikka and paneer tikka
Global comfort food, small plates and quick bites
Desserts, coffee, cold brews and frappes
Pet-friendly garden seating with space for groups

sections.heading: Where we are
paragraphs: Fernway is in Mayaganahalli, between Bidadi and Ramanagara, right on the Bangalore–Mysore Expressway (Mysore Road). Address: {{address}}. It's an easy late-night drive out of Bengaluru, and an easy stop if you're driving back from Mysuru.
Planning a late night with friends? Book a table online or call {{phone}} — weekends fill fast.
